visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) An Asian male with short black hair, wearing a black t-shirt and blue jeans, sits on a black shag rug in a modern indoor studio. He holds a small snack while a white Shiba Inu dog stands in front of him. A white cylindrical air purifier with a teal handle sits nearby. Lighting is bright and neutral. (2) A black-and-white historical photograph appears, showing three men in suits gathered around an early model ventilation device on a table. This is followed by a circular infographic featuring a logo and large white text over a blue background. (3) The man returns, gesturing toward the white air purifier. Close-up shots reveal the device's mesh air intake holes and a cross-section of three gray circular filters stacked together. He uses his hands to demonstrate the compact size of the machine. (4) A close-up view of the top interface shows a circular power button and an LED numerical display. A green mosquito coil is lit next to the machine, releasing thin wisps of smoke. A time-lapse sequence shows the display numbers rapidly fluctuating and the light ring changing from red to orange to green. (5) The man holds the air purifier by its teal strap, lifting it to show its portability. He turns the bottom base to demonstrate how the filter is removed. The scene shifts to product shots of the purifier with various colored straps (brown, pink, blue) and two additional filter units. (6) Finally, the man sits back on the rug, speaking directly toward the camera with open hand gestures. The studio background features textured gray walls and a vertical LED light strip.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with an upbeat, high-tempo electronic pop BGM featuring a driving synth bassline and crisp electronic percussion. A male voice speaks with high energy and clarity in Mandarin, introducing a dog. A sharp 'ding' sound effect highlights a text transition. (2) As the narration shifts to brand history, the music continues at a steady volume. The vocal tone is professional and persuasive, maintaining a fast but intelligible pace. Minimal background noise is present, suggesting a studio recording environment. (3) A subtle 'whoosh' transition SFX occurs as the narrator describes the machine's filtering technology. The interplay between the energetic voice and the rhythmic music remains balanced, with the vocals clearly sitting above the mix. (4) During the smoke test, a digital 'click' sound effect coincides with the display change. The narrator's pitch rises slightly with excitement while describing the rapid purification speed. The spectral brightness of the BGM increases as the build-up progresses. (5) The final phase features the narrator presenting a promotional offer. The vocal intensity increases to emphasize the price, followed by a final digital UI stinger sound effect as the video concludes, with the BGM fading out quickly.
